game_concept: A rhythm puzzle set in Frost Peaks – Snowline Trail, the trail at the snowline: the sherpa guide must handle avalanches while practicing strings & dictionaries. Core idea – Key Checkpoint: Check key membership with in before reading dictionary values.
theme: Frost Peaks – Snowline Trail: the trail at the snowline
core_gameplay_loop: In Snowline Trail, repeat each round: Check key membership with in before reading dictionary values. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the checkpoint value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Chain 10 consecutive correct decisions about checkpoint to power up the sherpa guide and open the rescue sled.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 8 – Strings & Dictionaries | Level 2 (intro tier): Key Checkpoint
assets_style: towering pixel-art mountains: glaciers, jagged ice ridges, crisp white and cyan with deep blue shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Key Checkpoint' (Week 8 slot 11), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Snowline Trail'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Frost Peaks
region.mood: thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how checkpoint changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against avalanches in Snowline Trail.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 10.
